etymologies.etymologyHTML: From French cocon, diminutive of coque (“shell”).

definitions.definition: The silky protective case spun by the larvae of some insects in which they metamorphose, the pupa.
Any similar protective case, whether real or metaphorical.
(transitive) To envelop in a protective case.

quote.text: Vern grabbed the throw draped over the back of the sofa and cocooned herself within it.

definitions.definition: (intransitive) To withdraw into such a case.
